title: Rugby: In-Season Pre-hab
author: Kaspar
desc:
In-Season Pre-hab for rugby players.
Can be done as warm-up or between sets of heavy exercices.

ex.note: Front, Back, Side

Controlled and Lightweight
Keep the weight over your hand, not on the side

- Short range, Use a Box to limi ROM
- Controlled Movement

Light
focus on movement and add Speed

Lightweight
Focus on movement and stability

Not more than 25% BW
We want to activate the Muscle
